info.title: LiquidGate
info.summary: The LiquidLabs platform's public API for the LiquidGold lending case.
info.description: Bearer API keys (`lg_<env>_…`, scoped, origin-allowlisted, rate-limited, x402-priced) or short-lived session tokens minted by the platform page. No cookie, no CSRF. Every write takes an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors are `{ok:false, error}`; 402 carries x402 payment terms; 501 marks a NEW beat that the hackathon builds on node C.

SettleDocument.description: One LiquidSettle screen. Shared slots: case_id · status_sentence · live_or_simulated {step: live|simulated} (what each record is) · modes {step: {requested, effective, why}} (Iteration 53: what the environment asked for, SETTLE_STEP_<KEY>, against the record) · links {platform, shipment, verify, receipt} · timeline[] {party, event, who, when, receipt_hash, explorer_url, platform_url, amount, simulated}; the rest is the screen's own (docs/LIQUIDSETTLE.md).

SettleConfig.description: Iteration 53 — the modes the environment set (plain variables on the server, never secrets). mode: SETTLE_MODE — live reads the person's own cases through LiquidGate, mock shows the sample data to everyone. steps[]: one row per LiquidSettle step — what was requested (SETTLE_STEP_<KEY>=live|simulated; usps follows USPS_MODE), whether the ledger can sign it here (possible), the effective mode, the primitive and transactions it signs with, and why.

get.description: Iteration 56. Whether lending is routed to the XLS-66 Collateral Lending devnet (network 424), the collateral field the codec learned from the node's server_definitions, and the latest lifecycle runs the platform signed there: every step with its expected and actual result and its hash, plus the three proofs (the release refused while the loan is open — tecPLEDGED —, the release after the payoff, the seizure on default). Addresses and hashes only; no keys, no operator.
